episodes.synopsis: Cocoa's first day at the Rabbit House Cafe is lively as she meets and becomes friends with Chino and Rize in a heartbeat.
episodes.title: I Knew at First Glance That It Was No Ordinary Fluffball

episodes.synopsis: While getting ready for the first day of school, Cocoa runs into a new friend at the park. Cocoa's and her friends decide to bake bread and visit Chiya's coffee house.
episodes.title: The Girl Who Loved Wheat and the Girl Loved by Azuki Beans

episodes.synopsis: Cocoa and company make a new friend, Sharo. Afterward, they enjoy some tea at Sharo's teahouse and spend the night at Rabbit House telling scary stories.
episodes.title: Do You Remember the Day You First Got Drunk? You Tried to Light a Campfire in Your Own Home, Didn't You?

episodes.synopsis: Cocoa practices her fortune telling technique using caffe-de-mancy, and the girls head to the library on a sunny afternoon.
episodes.title: Your Lucky Items Are Vegetables, Crime, and Punishment

episodes.synopsis: The girls begin practicing for the ball sports tournament at school, with unsurprising results. Father's Day is near, and Rize takes up extra jobs to get her father a gift.
episodes.title: Cocoa and Murderous Intent Without Malice

episodes.synopsis: Chino's friends help out at the Rabbit House and take a shining to Cocoa and Rize, leaving Chino the odd man out.
episodes.title: A Story About Telling a Story

episodes.synopsis: Chino and Cocoa get into small, cute fights with each other over puzzles and pancakes. Later, the girls hand out flyers for their cafes.
episodes.title: Call Me Sister

episodes.synopsis: Cocoa and the other girls take it upon themselves to teach Rize how to swim at the hot spring pool. Late, they watch a movie based on Aoyama's book together.
episodes.title: Wet with Pool Water, Wet with Rain, Wet with Tears

episodes.synopsis: Chino learns from a stray paper airplane that Aoyama is quitting her job as a novelist and takes up a part-time job at the Rabbit House.
episodes.title: Aoyama Slump Mountain

episodes.synopsis: While Cocoa helps Chiya study for the upcoming exams, Megu and Maya help our at Rabbit House. Later, a trip to the pool is in order.
episodes.title: The Anti-Sister Battle Corps, AKA The Chimame Corps

episodes.synopsis: To celebrate the Christmas season, the girls decide to throw a Christmas party. Let the planning commence!
episodes.title: The Girl Dons a Red Coat and Drives a Team of Rabbits Across the Christmas Eve Night Sky

episodes.synopsis: Cocoa runs a fever, and the girls head out to get her some medicine. After she heals, Chino ends up with the mumps.
episodes.title: For You, I Can Sleep Late
